source_versions.service_requests_311: NYC Open Data 311 pavement-marking complaints since 2020
source_versions.vision_zero_crashes: NYPD Motor Vehicle Collisions pedestrian injured/killed since 2020 (h9gi-nx95)

pilot_boundary: Lower Manhattan south of Canal Street
scoring_method: sklearn logistic ranker (priority); heuristic paint/311 score is the baseline
eval_split: GroupKFold by neighborhood_id (train/test NTAs are disjoint)
product_claim: City-actionable inspection list of Lower Manhattan pedestrian crossings that look degraded or under-marked relative to Vision Zero crash and 311 complaint burden.
caveat: Not a crosswalk detector and not a pretty-paint ranking. Crash labels are noisy / weakly supervised. Metrics use a spatial (neighborhood) split so train and test NTAs are disjoint. Small n: treat AUC as directional, not a production SLA.
